summary: JOHANNA DEMKER (org. no. 982 047 722) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Lunner, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2000-06-26. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 90.201 (Utøvende kunstnerisk virksomhet og underholdningsvirksomhet innenfor musikk); it has 0 registered employees.
